The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of a transfection medium with a high viscosity, as well as the centrifugation of polyplex solutions to speed up their sedimentation on cell monolayers, are simple but highly effective approaches to enhance the efficiency of PEI-mediated gene delivery.
, when dealing with polyplexes of different size, the same transfection protocol should not be blindly used, as the best conditions for each size must be determined.

, to obtain optimal transfection efficiency in vitro, polyplex size should be carefully controlled and, in some cases, the gravitational sedimentation onto cells should be promoted by centrifugation to speed up the settling process.
